logline: The Simulation Argument: You assume your senses show raw reality. Bostrom's argument does not prove you live in a simulation - it proves you cannot rule it out. Backed by Nick Bostrom (3 Horns, 1 Choice).
director_vision: An intimate psychological thriller aesthetic in 3D Tactile Spatial Documentary (Humanized PBR). Grounding abstract decision theory in tangible physical textures, dramatic directional chiaroscuro, and purposeful camera choreography that mirrors the cognitive trap of The Simulation Argument.
soundtrack_theme: Analog suspense score anchored at 45Hz sub-bass, Mid/Side vocal pocket ducking, and tactile physical Foley reflecting The Simulation Argument.

scenes.text: You cannot prove you are not living inside a simulation. In 2003 Oxford's Nick Bostrom showed exactly why that is a problem.
